raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #45512. `FanOutCommunicator.queueing_call` awaited the all-rank reply
event with no deadline while holding the queueing lock, so a silent scheduler
rank (e.g. SIGSTOP'd) left `/flush_cache` without an HTTP response until the
client timed out, and subsequent calls on the same communicator could not
dispatch until the active call finished.

## Modifications

- New `queueing_timeout` constructor argument (default
  `DEFAULT_QUEUEING_TIMEOUT = 300.0` seconds; `None` disables the deadline and
  restores the legacy unbounded wait). The deadline covers the whole call:
  waiting for the slot behind an earlier call plus waiting for the call's own
  rank replies.
- On expiry the caller gets a new `FanOutTimeoutError` (a `TimeoutError`
  subclass) instead of hanging -- a defined worker-failure outcome rather
  than relying solely on the client's HTTP timeout.
- Response ownership is preserved: a call that times out *after* dispatch
  keeps the slot until its rank replies drain (`handle_recv` releases it once
  the captured reply count is reached). Late replies drain into the orphaned
  collector and can never be consumed by -- or complete -- a later call, and
  partial results are never reported as successful all-rank completion.
  A call that times out *before* dispatch never owned the slot and simply
  reports the timeout without sending.
- External cancellation and send failures keep the previous behavior (slot
  freed immediately). This is complementary to #42694, which addresses
  cancellation ownership; that PR's scope is unchanged by this change.
- `watching_call` is untouched.

## Reproducer (before / after, verbatim)

CPU reproducer loading the real communicator module (fan-out 2, only one
rank reply supplied; the second scenario uses `queueing_timeout=0.5` to keep
the demo short -- the default is 300s):

Before (pre-fix code):
```
timeout param ABSENT (pre-fix code)
first call: STILL PENDING after 2.0s (elapsed=2.15s)
dispatch_count=1 (second caller dispatched: False)
second call done: False
```

After (with the fix):
```
first call: FanOutTimeoutError after 0.50s
  message: FanOutCommunicator queueing call timed out after 0.5 seconds waiting for 2 rank replies
dispatch_count=1 (second caller not yet created)
dispatch_count=1 (late reply not yet drained)
dispatch_count=2 (slot freed after drain, second dispatched)
second call returned: ['rank0-reply-2', 'rank1-reply-2']
```

The timed-out call raises instead of hanging; the later caller cannot
dispatch until the late reply drains; the late reply never leaks into the
later call's results.

## Tests

- New `test/registered/unit/managers/test_fanout_communicator_timeout.py`
  (registered in `base-a-test-cpu`, 5 tests): default-timeout value,
  silent-rank fail-fast + orphan-drain ownership, pre-dispatch timeout never
  sends, success within the deadline, and `queueing_timeout=None` preserving
  the unbounded wait.
- Existing `test/registered/unit/managers/test_fanout_communicator.py`
  (FIFO ordering) still passes: 6/6 green on CPU-only Python 3.12.
- Edge cases verified: external cancellation still raises `CancelledError`
  with the slot freed immediately; send failures propagate with the slot
  freed; `queueing_timeout=0` fails fast; `watching_call` is unaffected; a
  `TimeoutError` raised by `send` itself propagates unchanged (not converted
  to `FanOutTimeoutError`).
- `ruff check --select=F401,F821,F823,UP037` (the repo's pre-commit rule
  set), `ruff format --check`, `isort --check-only`, and `git diff --check`
  all pass.

## Accuracy Tests

No model or kernel changes; accuracy testing not run.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Control-plane only; no inference path changes. Not run.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

implementation, and tests); the author reviewed every changed line.

Thank you for reviewing!

@@ -9,6 +9,25 @@
 
 T = TypeVar("T")
 
+#: Default deadline, in seconds, for a queueing control call to be admitted
+#: and collect all rank replies. Bounds the wait so that a silent scheduler
+#: rank fails the call with :class:`FanOutTimeoutError` instead of hanging
+#: until the client's HTTP timeout. ``None`` disables the deadline (legacy
+#: unbounded wait). Individual communicators can override it via the
+#: ``queueing_timeout`` constructor argument.
+DEFAULT_QUEUEING_TIMEOUT: float = 300.0
+
+
+class FanOutTimeoutError(TimeoutError):
+    """A queueing control call did not finish within its deadline.
+
+    Raised to the caller when the deadline expires before all rank replies
+    are collected (e.g. a silent scheduler rank). The in-flight request's
+    slot stays owned by the timed-out call until its rank replies drain, so
+    a late reply can never be consumed by -- or complete -- a later call,
+    and partial results are never reported as successful all-rank completion.
+    """
+
 
 class FanOutCommunicator(Generic[T]):
     """Fan-out request + collect response primitive over zmq.
@@ -20,41 +39,87 @@ class FanOutCommunicator(Generic[T]):
       receive the same result when it completes.
 
     Only one request is in-flight at any time in either mode.
+
+    In "queueing" mode, a call that does not finish within `queueing_timeout`
+    seconds raises :class:`FanOutTimeoutError` to the caller instead of
+    waiting indefinitely.
     """
 
     def __init__(
         self,
         send: Callable[[T], None],
         fan_out: int,
         mode: str = "queueing",

+        # already gave up on the deadline; late replies keep draining into
+        # the orphaned collector until the slot is released.
+        self._queueing_call_abandoned = False

         # callers are still waiting, so requests are strictly serialized in
-        # arrival order. It also releases on exception/cancellation, so a
-        # failed caller never blocks the callers queued behind it.
-        async with self._queueing_lock:

+        # timeout; a call that times out after dispatch reports the timeout
+        # but keeps the slot until its rank replies drain (see handle_recv),
+        # so late replies cannot complete a later call.
+        cm = asyncio.timeout(self._queueing_timeout)
+        dispatched = False

+            async with cm:

+"""Deadline regressions for FanOutCommunicator.queueing_call (issue #45512).
+
+A silent scheduler rank must not leave a queueing control call waiting
+without a deadline: the call fails fast with FanOutTimeoutError, while the
+slot stays owned by the timed-out call until its rank replies drain, so a
+late reply can never be consumed by -- or complete -- a later call.
+"""
+
+import asyncio
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.srt.managers.communicator import (
+    DEFAULT_QUEUEING_TIMEOUT,
+    FanOutCommunicator,
+    FanOutTimeoutError,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class TestQueueingCallTimeout(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_default_timeout_is_explicit(self):
+        # The deadline is on by default; None opts back into the legacy
+        # unbounded wait.
+        self.assertEqual(DEFAULT_QUEUEING_TIMEOUT, 300.0)
+        comm = FanOutCommunicator(send=lambda obj: None, fan_out=1)
+        self.assertEqual(comm._queueing_timeout, 300.0)
+        comm = FanOutCommunicator(
+            send=lambda obj: None, fan_out=1, queueing_timeout=None
+        )
+        self.assertIsNone(comm._queueing_timeout)
+
+    def test_silent_rank_fails_fast_and_slot_frees_after_drain(self):
+        """fan-out 2, only one rank replies: the first call raises
+        FanOutTimeoutError at the deadline (not partial results). The slot
+        stays owned by the timed-out call, so a later caller cannot dispatch
+        until the late reply drains -- and that late reply is consumed by the
+        orphaned collector, never by the later call."""
+
+        async def scenario():
+            sent = []
+            comm = FanOutCommunicator(
+                send=sent.append, fan_out=2, mode="queueing", queueing_timeout=1.0
+            )
+
+            first = asyncio.create_task(comm("A"))
+            await asyncio.sleep(0)
+            comm.handle_recv("A-0")  # only rank 0 replies; rank 1 is silent
+
+            start = asyncio.get_running_loop().time()
+            with self.assertRaises(FanOutTimeoutError):
+                await asyncio.wait_for(first, timeout=10)
+            elapsed = asyncio.get_running_loop().time() - start
+            # Fails fast at the deadline instead of hanging without one ...
+            self.assertLess(elapsed, 10)
+            # ... and partial results are never reported as success.
+            self.assertTrue(first.done() and first.cancelled() is False)
+
+            # A later caller cannot dispatch while the orphaned slot drains.
+            second = asyncio.create_task(comm("B"))
+            await asyncio.sleep(0.2)
+            self.assertEqual(sent, ["A"])
+            self.assertFalse(second.done())
+
+            # The silent rank recovers: its late reply drains into the
+            # orphaned collector, freeing the slot for the next call.
+            comm.handle_recv("A-1")
+            for _ in range(1000):
+                if sent == ["A", "B"]:
+                    break
+                await asyncio.sleep(0)
+            self.assertEqual(sent, ["A", "B"])
+
+            # The late A-1 reply must not leak into B's results.
+            comm.handle_recv("B-0")
+            comm.handle_recv("B-1")
+            self.assertEqual(await asyncio.wait_for(second, timeout=10), ["B-0", "B-1"])
+
+        asyncio.run(scenario())
+
+    def test_timeout_before_dispatch_never_sends(self):
+        """A caller that times out while queued behind an abandoned slot
+        never dispatches its request."""
+
+        async def scenario():
+            sent = []
+            comm = FanOutCommunicator(
+                send=sent.append, fan_out=1, mode="queueing", queueing_timeout=0.5
+            )
+            first = asyncio.create_task(comm("A"))
+            await asyncio.sleep(0)
+            self.assertEqual(sent, ["A"])
+            # No rank ever replies: the first call's deadline expires after
+            # dispatch (orphan keeps the slot), while the queued second
+            # caller's own deadline expires first -- without ever sending.
+            second = asyncio.create_task(comm("B"))
+            with self.assertRaises(FanOutTimeoutError):
+                await asyncio.wait_for(first, timeout=5)
+            with self.assertRaises(FanOutTimeoutError):
+                await asyncio.wait_for(second, timeout=5)
+            self.assertEqual(sent, ["A"])
+
+        asyncio.run(scenario())
+
+    def test_call_within_deadline_succeeds(self):
+        async def scenario():
+            sent = []
+            comm = FanOutCommunicator(
+                send=sent.append, fan_out=2, mode="queueing", queueing_timeout=5
+            )
+            task = asyncio.create_task(comm("A"))
+            await asyncio.sleep(0)
+            comm.handle_recv("A-0")
+            comm.handle_recv("A-1")
+            self.assertEqual(await asyncio.wait_for(task, timeout=5), ["A-0", "A-1"])
+            self.assertEqual(sent, ["A"])
+
+        asyncio.run(scenario())
+
+    def test_timeout_none_preserves_unbounded_wait(self):
+        async def scenario():
+            sent = []
+            comm = FanOutCommunicator(
+                send=sent.append, fan_out=1, mode="queueing", queueing_timeout=None
+            )
+            task = asyncio.create_task(comm("A"))
+            await asyncio.sleep(0)
+            # No deadline: still pending after a grace period, then the
+            # reply completes it normally.
+            await asyncio.sleep(0.2)
+            self.assertFalse(task.done())
+            comm.handle_recv("A-0")
+            self.assertEqual(await asyncio.wait_for(task, timeout=5), ["A-0"])
+
+        asyncio.run(scenario())
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
